title: Time-course transcriptome analysis identifies rewiring patterns of transcriptional regulatory networks in rice under Rhizoctonia solani infection.
authors: Das, Akash; Moin, Mazahar; Sahu, Ankur; Kshattry, Mrinmoy; Kirti, Pulugurtha Bharadwaja; Barah, Pankaj
one_liner_zh: 该文通过时间序列转录组和机器学习构建水稻感染纹枯病菌的转录调控网络，虽涉及转录因子调控，但缺乏蛋白质-DNA三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: Sheath Blight (SB) disease in rice is caused by the infection from the fungal pathogen Rhizoctonia solani (R. solani). SB is one of the most severe rice diseases that can cause up to 50% yield losses in rice. Naturally occurring rice varieties resistant to SB have not been reported yet. We have performed a Time-Series RNA-Seq analysis on a widely cultivated rice variety BPT-5204 for identifying transcriptome level response signatures during R. solani infection at 1st, 2nd and 5th day post infection (dpi). In total, 428, 3225 and 1225 genes were differentially expressed in the treated rice plants on 1, 2 and 5 dpi, respectively. GO and KEGG enrichment analysis identified significant processes and pathways differentially altered in the rice plants during the fungal infection. Machine learning and network based integrative approach was used to construct rice Transcriptional Regulatory Networks (TRNs) for the three time points. TRN analysis identified SUB1B, MYB30 and CCA1 as important regulatory hub transcription factors in rice during R. solani infection. Jasmonic acid, salicylic acid, ethylene biogenesis and signaling were induced on infection. SAR was up regulated, while photosynthesis and carbon fixation processes were significantly down regulated. Involvement of MAPK, CYPs, peroxidase, PAL, chitinase genes were also observed in response to the fungal infection. The integrative analysis identified seven putative SB resistance genes differentially regulated in rice during R. solani infection.
abstract_zh: 水稻纹枯病（Sheath Blight, SB）是由真菌病原体立枯丝核菌（Rhizoctonia solani, R. solani）感染引起的。SB是水稻最严重的病害之一，可导致水稻产量损失高达50%。目前尚未报道天然存在对SB具有抗性的水稻品种。我们对广泛栽培的水稻品种BPT-5204进行了时间序列RNA-Seq分析，以鉴定在感染后第1天、第2天和第5天（dpi）R. solani感染期间的转录组水平响应特征。总共，在处理的水稻植株中，分别有428、3225和1225个基因在1、2和5 dpi时差异表达。GO和KEGG富集分析鉴定了真菌感染期间水稻植株中显著改变的重要生物学过程和通路。采用机器学习与基于网络的整合方法构建了三个时间点的水稻转录调控网络（Transcriptional Regulatory Networks, TRNs）。TRN分析鉴定出SUB1B、MYB30和CCA1为R. solani感染期间水稻中的重要调控枢纽转录因子。茉莉酸、水杨酸、乙烯生物合成及信号传导在感染时被诱导。系统获得性抗性（SAR）上调，而光合作用和碳固定过程显著下调。还观察到MAPK、CYPs、过氧化物酶、PAL、几丁质酶基因参与对真菌感染的响应。整合分析鉴定出七个推定的SB抗性基因在R. solani感染期间于水稻中差异调控。
